notes.title: Demo v0.03a Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed a typo in Ashter's scenario
[*]Lasers now have proper "spawn clouds" and stars at the ends
[*]Changed Japanese name of Uber River (ウーバーの川 → ウーバー川)
[*]Star and moon particles now appear on the title screen menus
[*]Replay time display is now 24 hours instead of 12 hours am/pm
[*]Fixed a bug where certain special attack names don't appear for some players
[*]Reduced brightness on Anya's special attack BG to improve visibility
[*]Made Feldonian Regalia easier; glowing bullets no longer have hitboxes, crystal bullets will not hit the player until they start moving
[*]Fixed "Trial Version" display in Japanese mode
[*]Fixed a bug in Hex Doll on Absurd difficulty where 2 of the dolls always have English quotes even in Japanese mode
[*]Fixed a layering issue where the underline on the special attack name appears behind enemy bullets
[*]Increased the attack power for Ashter's shot options
[list]
[*][b]Ashter A DPS on Full Power[/b]
Focused 79.4 → 87.8
Unfocused 83.0 → 86.6
[*][b]Ashter B DPS on Full Power[/b]
81.0 → 85.0
[/list]
[*]Players now have the option to adjust player hitbox visibility (Always on/Always off/Focus only)
[*]Stage 1 spiral bullets are no longer horizontal when pausing the game
[*]Fixed a bug where practice scores from stage practice were not being saved
[*]Fixed a bug where pausing the game affects bosses' move animations
[*]Fixed a bug where the special attack ring follows the player after clearing a time-out special attack even if the player failed the bonus
[*]Point and power rupee items now glimmer like youkou items
[*]Upon losing all lives, a yellow "full power" rupee will appear for the player to collect, instead of the player automatically continuing at full power
[*]Fixed a bug where selecting Retry on the Continue screen restarted the current stage instead of restarting at Stage 1
[*]Fixed a bug on the regular pause screen where entering the Yes/No confirm menu after selecting Retry reset the player's score
[*]Removed the gaussian blur effect when navigating the pause menus and replaced it with a simple "flip" effect similar to the effect in Shoot the Bullet's pause menu
[*]Changed youkou requirement for entering Bewitched Mode on Absurd difficulty (350 → 320)
[*]Music Room now shows a music note next to the track that is currently playing, track is also highlighted in blue
[*]Updated Shuuka-jima's design (title screen island)
[/list]

notes.title: Demo v0.02a Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Bewitched Mode no longer activates automatically. The player must activate it with the C key when at least one gauge is full
[*]The player no longer loses a life when hit by a bullet in Bewitched Mode, though the bonuses are still lost
[*]When getting hit by an enemy bullet in Bewitched Mode, the player has temporary invincibility (~1/2 second) and some of the enemy bullets in the player's general area are cleared
[*]Fixed a bug where Bewitched Mode disables deathbombing
[*]Special Attacks can now be practiced with any character and shot type, as long as it has been encountered at least once character shot type, it is no longer character-specific
[*]Bewitched Mode PIV Increase counter is now visible while still in Bewitched Mode
[*]The magic circle effect in Bewitched Mode starts out big and slowly shrinks, to indicate how much time is left in Bewitched Mode
[*]Fixed a bug where Anya's 1st boss special attack moves faster in 120fps
[*]"Feldonian Regalia" - Made crystal bullet circles smaller on Platinum phase
[*]Reduced screenshake on Anya's 1st boss special attack
[*]Fixed a bug where CarolineA's focused bomb didn't fade away completely in 120fps
[*]Extended area for bullets to be deleted off-screen
[*]Fixed a typo in Caroline's Stage 2 dialogue
[*]Music fades out more slowly at the end of stage 3
[*]The last digit in the Special Attack Bonus is now always 0
[*]Fixed a bug where, in the Special Attack Practice menu, players can practice attacks they haven't encountered/unlocked when they have scrolled down the menu
[*]Updated still image used for stage 3 still background to reflect the darker water color in the full background
[*]Hex Dolls in Hexnas's 2nd boss attack now spawn slightly lower on the screen, so the speech bubbles are easier to read
[*]Large circle bullets in Anya's last special attack are now immune to bombs
[*]Fixed a bug where pressing the confirm button when cursor is on "Boss BG Distortion" brought up the Stage BG Detail menu
[*]Threshold for the amount of youkou required to enter Bewitched Mode is now different per difficulty
[*]Anya's boss normal attacks have higher bullet density in Absurd difficulty
[*]Anya has a new special attack background
[*]The player can now press the X key to skip the animation on the Stage Clear screen
[*]Blue rupees now change into red rupees when the player is at full power (The result is the same as before where red rupees for power acted as blue rupees for points when at full power)
[*]Fixed a bug where, when a stage ends while the player is in Bewitched Mode and they earn enough pieces for an extra life or bomb, the remaining pieces were not added
[*]Fixed a bug where timing out a non-survival special attack in Special Attack Practice incorrectly counted it as a successful capture
[/list]

notes.title: Demo v0.01b Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Changed life piece requirement from 5 to 7
[*]Changed magic item requirement to enter bewitched mode from 350 to 250
[*]Added a counter to top and bottom of Youkou gauge
[*]Fixed first stage 1 enemies shooting multiple bullets on top of each other
[*]Bewitched Mode adds to PIV
[*]Star and Moon items change appearance when Bewitched Mode is active
[*]Magic meters are only reduced to 75% instead of 50% on death
[*]Added “character belongs to” in each character’s profile
[*]Sarnari midboss and boss have less health on each phase
[*]Corrected typos in Manual
[*]Fixed a bug where restarting special attack practice would put the player in stage 1
[*]The Yes/No prompt no longer appears when using Quick Retry on the pause menu with the R key
[*]The number of times continued is now the last digit of the player's score
[*]Increased the number of frames allowed for deathbombing from 10 to 14
[*]Slightly increased item collection radius
[*]Reduced timer on all boss phases to either 45 or 40 seconds
[*]When earning achievements, the in-game popup now shows all achievements at once, instead of one after another
[*]Made gravestones in the stage 2 background smaller
[*]Player will now earn one extra life piece in every other Bewitched Moon Mode
[*]Multiple Life/Bomb pieces dropped when Bewitched Mode ends are now closer together
[*]Reduced the brightness of the white foam on the water in the stage 3 background
[*]Fixed a glitch where skipping through dialogue on practice mode causes the dialogue portraits to hang in front of the pause menu
[*]Player can no longer graze when they have invincibility frames
[*]CarolineA's lasers are no longer rendered on top of enemy bullets
[*]Demo play is disabled temporarily, will be re-enabled in a future patch
[*]Slowed down "safezone-eliminating" shuriken bullets in Sarnari's 1st boss special attack
[*]Changed "shimmering" sound heard when starting a game
[*]There is now a 2-second period after the boss is defeated before starting the next stage when the dialogue is turned off
[*] Hexnas's 2nd normal boss phase shoots amulets in 1 direction instead of 3
[/list]
